correctness.rationale: For H_d={x↦1[dist_H(x,c)=2]}, after a positive first query the center options are edges of K_d. Any subsequent exact-distance-two query with support Z is positive only for weights 0,2,4, corresponding to all edges, K_{2,d-2} cut, or six inside edges; other weights give none. The two-star K_{2,m} has online rank at most 3: in potentially large positive branches, a further query leaves one child with <=3 hypotheses. Hence the positive root branch rank≤4 and global rank≤5 for all d. Complement duplicate centers at d4 and cardinality give low-d upper limits. Exact full shattered trees at d2,3,5,7 yield all lower bounds by zero-padding. Independently verified all 54 leaf paths of four actual Git JSON witnesses and computed ranks 0,1,2,2,4 in d1..5 by separate memo recursion.
residual_risks: General bound is a structural argument, not extrapolated from dimension 7.
Witnesses are for deterministic realizable Littlestone, not randomized/proper-only mistakes.
